question: Which museum fall within 130 kilometers when heading from Sloth Encounters, Hauppauge, NY toward Pace African & Oceanic Art, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.210029 40.824517)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.006282 40.747606)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.210029 40.824517)',4326)::geography, 130000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.210029 40.824517)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
